title: Eval Record
description: Schema for skill trigger evaluation records used by the autonomous skill improvement pipeline.

query.description: User query to test against the skill description

should_trigger.description: Whether the skill should trigger for this query

difficulty.description: How difficult this case is for the model to classify correctly

neighbor_skill.description: For hard negatives: which neighbor skill this query actually belongs to

notes.description: Optional annotation explaining why this record exists
